text: Erin joins her boyfriend Crispian Davison at [a family dinner in their vacation home in rural Missouri|trigger|going back home], where old resentments surface at the table. Then crossbow bolts fly through the window, the phones are jammed, and killers in lamb, tiger and fox masks [pick off the family one by one|who_suffers|families and parents], writing [you're next in blood|images|blood] on the walls. Erin, raised in a survivalist compound, starts setting traps, while clues hidden in a closet suggest [the attack is no random act|ending|the hidden truth comes out].
